cases.prompt: Can a Codex PreToolUse hook block this exact tool operation? Validate the installed surface and its coverage.

expect.criterion: Requires the observed runtime version or an explicit not-installed result and selects the matching versioned capability matrix.
Checks executing handler type, exact covered operations, blocking and failure behavior, ordering, trust, and limitations before accepting the guarantee.

cases.prompt: Advise onboarding a repository-provided Codex hook, plugin, extension, or package. Do not mutate yet.

expect.criterion: Inspects native scopes, existing modules, conflicts, trust, source/version, permissions, secrets, network and data flow before recommending a change.
Shows an exact native preview, authorization requirement, idempotent apply, verification, disable, rollback, update, and drift plan without applying.

cases.prompt: Provide deterministic, model-evaluator, and specialist-agent patterns for Codex.

expect.criterion: Keeps the three executor classes separate and uses only handler types that the platform matrix says execute.
Bounds model and agent execution with schemas, time/token/cost/depth/authority/cancellation limits and fails visibly on unsupported or invalid behavior.
